facts: deriveComposition derives operatorConfirmation from composition-policy.profiles, not raw composition.assets.
operator-confirmation CLI requires truthy sessionId, then work.assertCurrent(sessionId).
work-session assertCurrent strictly compares supplied sessionId with current null.
createOperatorConfirmation binds ordinary permit to currentSession() directly; it does not use installationId fallback.
Initial adopt-host creates only host-adoption and explicitly returns lifecycleEpoch=false; no work session is created.
Montage mandate supports media-import, layer-overlay and comp-frame-export only; no titles-current-target or project-save.
